'''Gadren Grady''' is the young son of [[Jur Grady|Jur]] and [[Sora Grady]].

== Appearance ==
He is big for his age, but about as pretty as a stump. In {{ne|999}}, he was four years old.{{ref/book|6|3}}

==Activities==
Gadren was held by his mother when [[Rand al'Thor]] visits the [[Black Tower]].{{ref/book|6|3}} 

Just prior to the [[Last Battle]], his father kept trying to [[Traveling|Travel]] back to the Black Tower to see him, but was unable to do so due to [[Graendal]]'s [[dreamspike]].{{ref/book|13|10}}

==Gaidal Cain Speculation==
It has been speculated, due to his ugliness, that he is [[Gaidal Cain]] reborn. Given that he was already four in Lord of Chaos and that Gaidal Cain had disappeared before that, it seems unlikely that this is the case. Jordan has also commented in an interview on this impossibility. <ref>CoT Signing report, Jan 16 2003, Q23 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=161#23]</ref>

Brandon Sanderson, however, indicated that he both knows who Gaidal is and left a clue in [[Towers of Midnight]] about his identity.<ref>AMOL Signing Report, Feb 1 2013, Q3 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=915]</ref><ref>Goodreads ToM Fantasy Book Club Q&A with Brandon Sanderson, Dec 2010, Q7 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=588]</ref> In a later interview he hinted that Gadren would be too old.<ref>Twitter, Jan 22nd 2013, Q51 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=874]</ref>

He later admitted that Grady has multiple children. The new theory, practically confirmed by Sanderson, is that Gaidal is another son of Grady that is either just born or recently conceived.<ref> aMoL Signing Report, Feb 22nd 2013, Q9 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=971]</ref><ref>AMOL Signing Report, Feb 16 2013, Q2 [https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=950]</ref>
